scope: Every extant pnpm member, target-only package and non-fixture native crate. MVP includes all inventoried feature, plugin, screen, browser-engine, Worker/API and storage areas. Supporting apps and SDK CLI/TUI/public authoring/installed consumers stay visible.

removed.reason: SCOPE-3 removal on 2026-10-21, SCOPE-8 hosted app, ARCH-1 Effect Workers; old Go/credits/desktop app acceptance does not authorize restoration.
removed.landing: Historical mythical/Smithers Cloud/owner-PR wording is superseded for this repository by HOST-3/HOST-4 and the explicit Mac lander lane contract. No GitHub writes, deployments or wiki publication in B31.

assertions: lifecycle, cancellation, crash recovery and idempotency
unit.coverage: Four measured dimensions at 100% where instrumentation supports them, exact production denominator, all configured exclusions and ignored branches listed, child-process and platform evidence separate. A configured floor is never measured coverage. Unsupported instrumentation stays an unresolved qualification, not zero work or a silent exemption.
unit.faults: Inject a faulty Effect service. No mocks, retries, increased timeouts, reduced assertions or lowered floors.

dependencies: real host services, cleanup and cancellation
integration.rule: A standalone invocation must establish the result without running the unit suite first. Faults cross real boundaries through injected faulty Effect services.

cases: browser 5xx, request, console and page error watchers
artifacts: video and console on UI failure
e2e.rule: No route mocks, fake backend or build-only durability claim. Agents never approve or merge customer PRs. No production writes or spending by B31.

fuzz.tool: Existing pinned fast-check and packages/repo-targets/test-utils/effect-property.mjs; packages/repo-targets/test/EffectProperty.test.ts proves ambient services, cleanup, replay and shrinking. No new dependency.
classes: public CLI syntax and persisted-history decoding
retain: original and minimized counterexample bytes and SHA-256
actual completed run count, budget and termination reason
fuzz.rule: Budgets bound a campaign; they never raise an owning test timeout or count a timed-out campaign as passed. Both bounded and long cells remain required.

retain: correctness assertions and independently expected output hashes
fixture roster and useful work counts
benchmark.rule: Never replace a baseline automatically. Existing deterministic cost gates remain authoritative. Shared-host wall times and compile-only Windows evidence do not establish live performance or runtime qualification.

reproduction: environment variable names only in limitations
receipt.artifacts: Repository-relative paths under this directory with kind and SHA-256; verifier reads actual bytes and rejects symlink escape. Include raw logs plus machine test/coverage/trace/counterexample/sample reports. Never store secrets or authenticated session files.
receipt.review: Structural integrity is not process attestation. A reviewer must compare raw machine reports and counters, assertions, exact source, tool output and limitations. Fixture receipts in tests never enter ledger.json.
receipt.aggregation: No unit result qualifies integration, no local result qualifies live, no configured floor qualifies coverage, no empty inventory completes. Red receipts and skipped cases stay visible; preparation is not campaign completion.

ownerHandoff: Record failing command, exact source, raw artifact, cause, proposed regression and owner lane in handoffs.json. B31 writes only its campaign directory and status; implementation fixes belong to owner batches. No owner acknowledgment is assumed.
